title: Greek-Style Pork Gyro
description: A delicious and easy-to-make recipe for a classic Greek dish. The combination of tender pork, crispy onions, and creamy tzatziki sauce makes this gyro a must-try.
instructions: Season the pork with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Grill the pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, olives, feta, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Mix well to combine and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the onions thinly and separate them into individual rings.
Grill the onion rings until crispy and golden brown.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the gyro by spreading a layer of tzatziki sauce on the pita, followed by a few slices of pork, some crispy onions, and a sprinkle of olives.
